data.act: provision of a prebend in the church of Saint Martin of Combarieu
data.vacancy: siqua vacabat tunc aut cum vacaret
data.regest_de: Felix V. Provisions of a prebend in the church of Saint Martin of Combarieu to Master Bartholomew de Vivischotensi, cleric of the diocese of Trier, scribe and familiar of the Pope, granted in consideration of his services and merits, with the condition that the benefice was vacant or would become vacant, according to the statutes of the General Council of Basel.
data.regest_fr: Felix V. Provision d'une prébende dans l'église Saint-Martin de Combarieu à Maître Barthélemy de Vivischotensi, clerc du diocèse de Trèves, scribe et familier du Pape, accordée en considération de ses services et mérites, sous la condition que le bénéfice était vacant ou le deviendrait, conformément aux statuts du Concile général de Bâle.
data.regest_la: Felix V. Bartholomeo de Vivischotensi, clerico Traietten diocesis, scriptori et familiari nostro, prebenda ecclesie sancti Martini combariensis providetur, siqua vacabat tunc aut cum vacaret, juxta statuta generalis Basiliensis concilii, intuitu meritorum suorum.
